asks: Replace the interim Banff-Jasper district with a Canmore-Crowsnest Pass district and a Rocky Mountain House-Banff foothills district, and keep Jasper in West Yellowhead.

quote: There’s an underrepresentation going on there, and what I’m saying is that we need that area to have its own representation.
note: Proposes a Rocky Mountain House-Banff foothills district (headwaters, Highways 1, 11, 22, 40); the foothills west of Highway 22 should have their own representation. Does not name Clearwater County or Sundre's placement explicitly.

quote: The second is a Rocky Mountain House-Banff district spanning the Bow and North Saskatchewan headwaters.
note: Rocky Mountain House joined with Banff, including the Banff townsite: he would separate Banff from Canmore (Canmore goes to a Canmore-Crowsnest Pass district), so B9 not B1. Rejection of B3 rests on his critique: 'Several issues arise when the proposed Banff-Jasper district is examined through a functional lens.' (EB-516).

quote: the riding boundaries, if you notice, just touch on Cochrane a little bit
note: Cochrane named as a gateway community and as touched by his proposed district; no request about Cochrane's district.

asks: Do not create Calgary-Nose Creek and Calgary-Confluence; weigh elector counts, not only population, when setting Calgary ridings.

quote: number one is Airdrie-Cochrane
note: Airdrie-Cochrane named only as top of his population ranking chart; no stance.

quote: number one is Airdrie-Cochrane
note: Example only.

quote: you go into Lesser Slave Lake and of course you’re going to have some kind of deficits there
note: Example of justified elector deficit; no stance.

asks: Keep Montgomery in Calgary-Bow rather than moving it to Calgary-Varsity.

Consider the cumulative effect of the interim changes on Foothills school communities (Longview split, Okotoks drawn into Calgary) and explain in the final report how they serve effective representation.

quote: I would like to clarify that Foothills school division is not directly impacted by the proposed changes to Cochrane-Springbank.
note: Named only to say the division is not affected; no stance.

asks: Revisit the interim changes to Calgary-Acadia: keep Kingsland and Manchester in it and do not add Lake Bonavista.
Keep Calgary-Varsity's current boundaries, add another seat each in Calgary and Edmonton, and avoid hybrid ridings wherever possible.
Keep the interim Calgary-Falconridge and Calgary-Cross boundaries, and make the third added Calgary seat a fully urban seat instead of the Calgary-Okotoks hybrid.

quote: I think anything past that would be not conducive to good representation, especially when Chestermere has its own needs.
note: Accepts Conrich in Calgary-Cross but says extending the Calgary riding further, into Chestermere, would be bad: Chestermere has its own identity. Rejection only; no want stated.

quote: I do appreciate an additional riding being added to the Airdrie-Cochrane corridor that exists because that makes so much sense given how large Airdrie is now
note: Approves the interim added seat in the Airdrie-Cochrane corridor but says nothing of how Airdrie is divided; coded narrowly as a mention (could be read as A1 direction).

quote: an additional riding being added to the Airdrie-Cochrane corridor
note: Corridor named only; no stance on Cochrane's district.

asks: Redraw Calgary-Cross with 32nd Avenue as a boundary to keep Pineridge, Rundle, Marlborough and Marlborough Park together, adding Mayland Heights, Vista Heights and the Prince of Peace park.
Keep the interim Banff-Jasper district with Nordegg in it and Rocky Mountain House outside it, contrary to Clearwater County's proposed changes.

quote: Can I summarize your point, that you are in favour of the proposed boundary and you’re concerned about the Clearwater municipality’s position contrary to that? Is that correct? Mr. Maslanka: Yes. Yes, I am.
note: Answer of yes to the Chair's summary; also says yes ('Definitely') to Mrs. Samson asking whether Banff-Jasper is better than the old Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding. Supports the interim placement of western Clearwater County (Nordegg) in Banff-Jasper and opposes Clearwater County's submission; does not speak of the rest of the county.

quote: I think it’s important to keep Rocky Mountain House outside of the boundary. It’s great. I have to admit you did a great job by introducing this new Banff-Jasper boundary.
note: Supports the interim Banff-Jasper riding including Nordegg and the First Nations; explicitly against putting Rocky Mountain House in the park riding.

asks: Adopt the interim report's recommendations without change; questions whether hybrids share a community of interest.

quote: my argument to you would simply be that Airdrie and Cochrane share more in common than somebody between Airdrie and Calgary
note: Said in a general answer about hybrids; a comparison, not a request about how Airdrie is divided. Could be read as against an Airdrie-Calgary link (A2) but no words of rejection; coded narrowly.

quote: Airdrie and Cochrane share more in common than somebody between Airdrie and Calgary
note: Comparison only; no request about Cochrane's district.

asks: Give Calgary and Edmonton an extra seat each (keep Edmonton-Riverview) and do not over-represent the north; hybrids only as a last resort.
Place Sundre and western Mountain View County west of Highway 22 in a riding with Banff, the MD of Bighorn and Clearwater County, not with communities east of Highway 22.

quote: and western Mountain View county in a riding with Banff, MD of Bighorn, and Clearwater county.
note: Full sentence begins 'Consider placing Sundre' before the EB-547 page label. Highway 22 as the eastern boundary.

quote: The Chair: So you want Banff in your riding. Mr. Warnock: Yes.
note: Answer of yes to the Chair's question; also asks for a riding with Banff, the MD of Bighorn and Clearwater County (EB-547), west of Highway 22 'all the way to Banff, Jasper'. Does not say whether the Banff townsite or only park land; coded direction.

quote: It is our concern that placing Sundre with communities that are distinctively different than Sundre puts us in a position where we are at risk of losing effective representation.
note: Objects to the interim placement of Sundre with communities east of Highway 22 (Olds, Three Hills); wants Sundre in the foothills riding. O1 per codebook partial-request rule.

asks: Keep the interim Banff-Jasper riding, which unites Stoney, Big Horn, Sunchild and O'Chiese nations with the mountain parks, and move Priddis to Okotoks-Diamond Valley or High River-Vulcan.

quote: I support the proposed changes to the Banff-Kananaskis riding to create a Banff-Jasper riding for a couple really key reasons.
note: Supports interim Banff-Jasper including Big Horn, Sunchild and O'Chiese First Nations (western Clearwater County lands). Does not name Rocky Mountain House or Clearwater County; RMH-B coded because she speaks of the Clearwater-area nations joining the park riding. Record runs into Mr. Sabir; only Dr. Elmeligi coded.

quote: When Banff and Canmore were included in a riding with Cochrane, the needs of the smaller communities were often deemed less important or less urgent than the needs of Cochrane
note: Says the former Banff-Cochrane riding was 'really problematic'; a rejection of Cochrane with Banff and Canmore, on no current map. No want for Cochrane.

asks: Add another seat in Calgary and keep Calgary ridings fully urban, without rural areas such as Cochrane, Springbank, Okotoks and Bearspaw.

quote: there is no compelling reason to include rural areas like Cochrane, Springbank, Okotoks, and Bearspaw with Calgary ridings
note: General argument against Calgary hybrids naming Cochrane; the interim did not join Cochrane to Calgary. Rejection only.

quote: may not have as much in common with Calgary as they will have, for instance, with Chestermere- Strathmore and neighbouring communities
note: Chestermere-Strathmore named as a better home for areas outside Calgary (e.g. Conrich); no request about Chestermere itself.
